// Fast I/O classes
class FastWriter {
private:
    string out;
public:
    FastWriter() { out.reserve(128 * 1024); }
    
    FastWriter& p(const string& s) { out += s; return *this; }
    FastWriter& p(const char* s) { out += s; return *this; }
    FastWriter& p(char c) { out += c; return *this; }
    FastWriter& p(int n) { out += to_string(n); return *this; }
    FastWriter& p(long long n) { out += to_string(n); return *this; }
    FastWriter& p(double d) { 
       ostringstream ss;
        ss << fixed << setprecision(6) << d;
        out += ss.str();
        return *this;
    }
    FastWriter& p(bool b) { out += (b ? "true" : "false"); return *this; }
    
    template<typename T>
    FastWriter& pp(const vector<T>& v) {
        for (const auto& x : v) {
            out += to_string(x);
            out += " ";
        }
        out += "\n";
        return *this;
    }
    
    template<typename T>
    FastWriter& pp(const T& x) {
        out += to_string(x);
        out += " ";
        return *this;
    }
    
    template<typename T, typename... Args>
    FastWriter& pp(const T& first, const Args&... rest) {
        out += to_string(first);
        out += " ";
        pp(rest...);
        return *this;
    }
    
    void println(const string& s) { out += s + "\n"; }
    void println() { out += "\n"; }
    void println(int n) { out += to_string(n) + "\n"; }
    void println(long long n) { out += to_string(n) + "\n"; }
    void println(double d) {
       ostringstream ss;
        ss << fixed << setprecision(6) << d;
        out += ss.str() + "\n";
    }
    void println(bool b) { out += (b ? "true" : "false") + "\n"; }
    
    template<typename T>
    void println(const vector<T>& v) {
        for (const auto& x : v) {
            out += to_string(x);
            out += " ";
        }
        out += "\n";
    }
    
    template<typename T>
    void println(const vector<vector<T>>& v) {
        for (const auto& row : v) {
            for (const auto& x : row) {
                out += to_string(x);
                out += " ";
            }
            out += "\n";
        }
    }
    
    void flush() { cout << out; out.clear(); }
    ~FastWriter() { flush(); }
};

class FastScanner {
private:
    string buffer;
    size_t pos;
public:
    FastScanner() : pos(0) {
        ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
        cin.tie(nullptr);
    }
    
    bool hasNext() {
        if (pos >= buffer.size()) {
            if (!getline(cin, buffer)) return false;
            pos = 0;
        }
        while (pos < buffer.size() && isspace(buffer[pos])) pos++;
        return pos < buffer.size();
    }
    
    string next() {
        if (!hasNext()) throw runtime_error("No more tokens");
        string result;
        while (pos < buffer.size() && !isspace(buffer[pos])) {
            result += buffer[pos++];
        }
        return result;
    }
    
    int intNext() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
    
    long long longNext() {
        return stoll(next());
    }
    
    double doubleNext() {
        return stod(next());
    }
    
    vector<long long> nextLongArray(int n) {
        vector<long long> arr(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            arr[i] = longNext();
        }
        return arr;
    }
    
    vector<int> nextIntArray(int n) {
        vector<int> arr(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            arr[i] = intNext();
        }
        return arr;
    }
};

// Main solution class
class E {
private:
    void solver() {
        FastScanner in;
        FastWriter out;
        
        long long n = in.longNext();
        vector<long long> ar = in.nextLongArray(3);
        vector<long long> br = in.nextLongArray(3);
        long long mxWins = 0;
        long long mxLosesOrDraw = 0;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            mxWins += min(ar[i], br[(i + 1) % 3]);
            long long mxLose = min(br[i], ar[(i + 1) % 3]);
            long long mxDraw = min(br[i], ar[i]);
            mxLosesOrDraw += min(br[i], mxLose + mxDraw);
        }
        
        out.pp(n - mxLosesOrDraw, mxWins);
    }

public:
    static void main() {
        E solver;
        solver.solver();
    }
};

int main() {
    E::main();
    return 0;
